If you can’t connect the cameras in the first place because the app is faulty then how can you even consider signing up to a cloud service. This app is useless don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Mis-fires and delays
reviews.text: I have several cameras situated around the property. There are so many times that the event recognition misfires activity! My dogs leaving the porch are “vehicles leaving” and “a person wandering around” that alerts have now become noise and I avoid checking the app. The delay is recording an event is set to a low trigger because I want to record any movement on certain cameras but I end up only seeing a quick second of the event on screen. Often not enough time to capture a face or see which direction they came from. The clarity and night vision are decent enough that if I actually were to see enough of the recording I might actually be able to share with LE in the event of an incident. Network is stable and 2GB speed so I know it isn’t lag time on my end. Fix the AI recognition please!

reviews.title: Bird watching for $80/year? Nope!
reviews.text:
This was a nice Christmas/retirement gift to me a year ago. At that time, I could view short videos of my birds eating at the feeder for free. It was enjoyable! That feature is no longer available. As of Oct 2026, I must pay a subscription fee of $80 a year to see video! 
No thank you! Not in this economy! 
Putting food on the table and gas in my vehicle is more important than birdwatching videos, especially since the camera was mediocre and had a start delay. 

Currently, if you do not purchase a subscription plan, you will only see a blurry still photo of said bird, squirrel, or raccoon usually turning to leave due to the camera delay. 
My birdwatching camera has become useless and disappointing. 

Developers: Don’t bother to send me the canned “please contact support” response because I already tried and received no response. 

Also, I usually don’t leave poor reviews, but this software development change is a deceptive practice and I will be reporting it to FTC.gov. 

I’ll be looking into another brand… Thank you very much.

reviews.text: I bought many cameras from this company or one of its sister companies specifically because it did NOT REQUIRE A SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE, which is how it advertised itself, and it worked well for a year or two.  I even subscribed for a little while to their OPTIONAL “premium” monitoring service.  But the company has recently decided to completely screw over and even endanger their customers by adding excessive ads to the app, including a FORCED AD WHEN TRYING TO VIEW THE LIVE CAMERA OR FOOTAGE FROM THE CAMERA!  This is extremely dangerous for customers like me who utilized these for their advertised security purpose, and the inability to access my camera footage after strange activity was detected outside my child’s window could have ended in tragedy! These cameras have also been used for other equally critical purposes and the AD-gating to view footage is absolutely unacceptable.  This app should be removed from the marketplace, I am speaking to an appropriate professional to see if anything can be done to hold the company accountable for this.  STAY AWAY! Also, they recently added an option for a “lifetime” “single-payment” premium subscription, which is usually a sign of a last minute cash-grab before closing down a company.  And they had the audacity to push a notification to my phone requesting I allow them to collect data to use more targeted advertising on me! I am livid, NOT ONLY IS THE APP UNUSABLE, NO SO ARE THE CAMERAS I SPENT HUNDREDS OF DOLLARS BUYING AND INSTALLING

Now I have to pay to get it and if I don’t all I get is a screen shot and after hours finally the real footage? Do you know how bad that is? What if an emergency happens or someone is robbing you, you wouldn’t be able to tell unless you pay for a feature that should already come in the camera. The other subscription features I understand and are totally acceptable but having to pay to get view recordings is absolutely not in my opinion.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Useless without a subscription, delays recordings and sends thumbs of nothing after the person/vehicle has passed then have to watch an ad to view the recording and if lucky you see what passed. Also alerts you after someone has been to the door and you can watch them walking away after viewing another advert!

reviews.title: Merda
reviews.text:
Tenho essa câmera a alguns anos e sempre foi útil para meu propósito ! 
Semana passada ouve um atualização e agora n tem mais vídeo de deteção de pessoas apenas um freme do vídeo um imagem borrada !
Agora só vou colocar as câmeras dentro de casa que só serve para vigiar os Pet !

reviews.title: Update change
reviews.text:
I really don’t like the latest update on my cameras. I used to be able to open camera 1 or 2 separately, quick and easy….but now you’ve thrown both camera footage in together and I have to scroll and scroll to find what I’m looking for.
Why change something that already worked really well? Before this update I’d have given 4 stars but not anymore.

reviews.title: Going downhill fast
reviews.text: Unfortunately, once purchasing the cameras (I have four) you are locked into the companies plans to push you into subscription by massive ads and constant software updates (prob to steal your personal data) just as you are trying to use the cameras for safety of your home. They also took away free cloud storage. Eventually they are going to make these completely off putting and lose on camera sales big time. I’m already considering throwing these in the trash and switching to a wired system. They’ll prob tell me to complain elsewhere but I’m not wasting my time.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service.
reviews.text: We were heading out of town for an extended trip and went to set up our camera in our new apartment, having just recently moved. The camera wouldn’t connect to either of our devices. We contacted VicoHome customer service, but we’re not given any solutions. They just regurgitated the same instructions we were given to troubleshoot the device, which wasn’t working. A week later, we were charged for the annual subscription, which we had canceled since the device wasn’t working. We emailed customer service once again, but never received a response. I had to go through my bank to have the charge reversed and never heard back from VicoHome customer service. I would absolutely not recommend this app or company for a home camera surveillance setup. Look elsewhere if you value quality customer service and reliable products!

reviews.title: Ads on the screen
reviews.text: Used to be a nice app, but now has ads every time you start the app. They’re also very annoying ads, the type that tell you you’ve been compromised etc.

reviews.title: Remove or monitor ads
reviews.text:
This app used to have no advertisements at all, but with a recent update they’ve introduced ads. Normally this wouldn’t be such a horrible thing. However, this company clearly did not put any filters on their ads. For an example, one of the ads that have popped up multiple times for me is of an iPhone main page with a pop up saying “8 viruses detected on your iPhone, IOS is damaged at 72%. Further damage will result in device lockup and loss of all data within 2 minutes. Please click the button below to remove all viruses.”

I obviously knew this was a scam, but there are many people who would see this “ad” and click on it. For an app that’s about home security, this is shameful and downright disrespectful towards your customers. You need to implement filters for the ads on your app, or better yet, remove ads entirely!

reviews.title: Too many changes
reviews.text: Paid a monthly fee of £10 for unlimited devices which included video settings, adjustments and recordings. Worked well and happy with service. Now suddenly with no notification at all the app and price plans have changed completely, still happy to take my money even though I have lost what I had. Very poor and misleading, and very likely will end up with me cancelling altogether.

reviews.title: Literally won’t let me change subscription
reviews.text: I bought 2 more cameras for literal safety reasons they were very much needed and it’s giving me a bunch of error messages when I try to do the bundle plan for 9.99 i have sufficient funds I tried to add another card and it won’t even give me the option to fill it out. I sent a ticket and am waiting for a response it has nothing to do with updating the app or my phone cause both are updated in overly irritated there’s no actual support when something is wrong and who knows how long I have to wait for my ticket to get a response Aside from that my front door camera glitches quite a bit it’ll say there’s 3 mins worth of video but only give me 10 seconds of it SMH

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: The app will not work for longer than about 30 seconds at a time before it sends you back to the login screen. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app several times, have cleared the cache on my phone, everything. By the time the app opens, shows the thumbnails and I go to access a camera, I’m sent back to start all over again. It’s been like this for days on a 5 month old iPhone 17 Pro Max. I bought these in the fall but due to the way the mounts are made I had to await for better weather to install them, pushing me past the return window or honestly between being tied strictly to their app and the fact that the app doesn’t work, I’d send them back and get something better. I bought 2 2-packs of cameras for my home and can’t even use them $160 later. At least if you’re going to so strictly enforce only using your app, the app needs to be stable and working 99% of the time, not broken for days. I can’t even use the help in the app to contact anyone due to it not working. Junk.

reviews.title: Ads before I can see my cameras?
reviews.text: So glad I have to wait for ads before I can see my cameras now. God forbid anyone in the company use their brains on cost savings by, I don’t know, giving the option to not send notifications every second when a camera detects motion? The other camera system I use lets me set time between notifications so I’m not being spammed if I’m working near a camera. But these cameras? If you’re working in the area be prepared to be spammed with non stop notifications that someone was detected. So instead of improving their feature set, just throw ads on it that you’re forced to watch before you can view your SECURITY CAMERA. Sure hope I don’t have to sit through an ad while I’m trying to find out if I’m about to be murdered.

reviews.title: Suddenly has ads?!
reviews.text: Latest update had put ads that cover the screen and claim I’m hacked etc. I want to access my camera when I have a security concern, not be pestered by stupid advertising that covers everything up. That’s not acceptable and renders the fast access to footage impossible. Won’t be keeping this set up if it continues.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: You need to remove the adds from the app as it doesn’t make sense for a security camera as I wanna see who was passing my camera 5 minutes ago and ad soon as I tap on it you decide to show me an ad, it doesn’t make Sense when you shoe a ad on your app when it’s supposed to be for security…. Fix that right now or something bad will happen with your app

reviews.title: Ads everywhere
reviews.text: Latest update has forced advertisements every time you open the app. Disgusting

reviews.title: Disappoining Update
reviews.text: I have been using the app and cameras for a long time. The cameras don’t always last a long time but they are good quality when they work. The app has been user friendly and I feel good that I have access to cameras. Today I checked the app and a pop up said to allow ads so the app can remain free. I totally get it and although they are inconvenient I understand the need for income. However, the first ad that popped up was a scam saying my Apple ID has been compromised and to log in immediately to fix the situation. This is completely inappropriate and if this is how they are going to get income they need to close down this company/app on the Apple Store.

reviews.title: Ads and subscription pushes on something already purchased
reviews.text: App seems to work well if you put your blinders on to all of the ads.  However doing this is a testament of will and not what people will actually notice when using this virus of terrible ad implementation.  My daughter got a WiFi bird feeder for Christmas, so we were naturally excited to set this up and encourage her curiosity.  Unfortunately I got met with a google ad placed over the setup screen before I can even finish hooking it up to WiFi.  They make it inobvious how to close the ad as it partially obscures the “continue to app” link.  Then once you get it in asks to track your device data for ads, then asks you to subscribe to added services multiple times.  Ads and subscription popups continue multiple times anytime you use the app.  Folks, it’s a $5 plastic bird feeder with a $50 solar WiFi camera in it that cost $140.  Get over yourselves and show some appreciate for the people who bought this overpriced item and don’t harass them nonstop.

reviews.title: STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
When I first bought this birdhouse and started using this app, it was great. I could see the short videos of the birds and only had to pay extra if I wanted cloud storage. Mind you, the birdhouse itself was fairly expensive ($80) so it felt reasonable that I could see the short video (about ten seconds). 

Now, something changed, and EVERYTHING is behind a paywall that is more than the actual bird house cost. I can't see the video at all, I can only see the thumbnail, which often doesn't even include the bird.

I essentially paid $80 for a regular bird feeder, and it's absolutely disgusting that they did this. Stay away from this app and don't buy the bird feeder.

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: I bought one a couple years ago and it just stopped working after about 10 months. It also kept telling me there was notifications for a car in the driveway constantly or that something was moving weird notifications that weren’t happening .then I got a second one as a gift and for two days now we’ve been trying to connect it it will Take any credit or debit card that we put in. We even tried Apple Pay. It will not connect. There is no customer service phone number they want you to go through the website. there’s nothing about this on the website. I’m sorry, but if you’re selling a product, you should have customer service. For people to talk to I most likely will be throwing trash and buying a different name brand .buyer beware

reviews.title: 1)does not come out of sleep mode 2)needs auto rotate
reviews.text: Grandma got bird feeder as a gift. she is having hard time figuring these things out: 1) after tapping bird notification vicohome app shows camera in sleep mode even when it is scheduled at another time, you have to exit out of black sleep mode message and open app again then go to home tap arrow to connect so you can view the other vicohome notifications.   2)does not  auto rotate view after tapping bird notification, you have to find the little square in lower right corner of screen for each notification. also put it in “battery power only “after it was “solar panel settings” because battery kept dying, so confusing. mute feature is nice so you can watch birds in silence on her new iPad while watching tv.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: The camera was marketed with continuous recording to SD card and limited free cloud based storage of short motion captured clips. After a while it started only recording in the daytime. In the past year the company changed the app and their terms and the camera no longer saves continuous recordings to the local SD card, and requires a hefty subscription to view clips. Poor customer service and shady business practices are why I’m rating this one star. For two years these features worked as advertised and expected for price paid, and then out of the blue the pull the rug right from under you and essentially brick the item with an app update. Even after paying the annual subscription I’m unable to access the features I was used to, don’t get suckered into the subscription. It’s a cash grab, they’ve probably already re-rolled into another company, their own competitor so when word gets around and the company/apps rating tanks as it is now, they’ll be the ones to sell you your next cheap Chinese security cam. Spend the extra money and get a camera from a reputable manufacturer that cares about their brand.

reviews.title: Static/thudding non stop noise coming from iPhone.
reviews.text: Hello, I was enjoying Vicohome for about 2 months. Then I got a new device. For some reason my phone is emitting a loud static and thudding noise non stop that overlaps anything I try to listen to on my phone. I have had to restart my phone multiple times and it comes back shortly after opening the app again. It only stops if I am viewing the camera live or completely uninstalled the app and restart my phone again, sound will continue even if app is removed I have to completely restart and disable to app all together. I have no way to use my camera now without this problem persisting. I have the latest updates and my phone is updated. I tried multiple solutions like turning off push notifications, motion detection etc. Still no fix.
